svg.title: Two-minute dispatch during an analytical unpowered-coasting leg
svg.desc: Speed and front position from the selected flat-route analytical model. The following train launches at 120 seconds while the first is still travelling. This is not a levitated-train or safety simulation.
svg.text: A two-minute departure interval can overlap a longer journey
Selected analytical case: 2 km · 218.7s moving · 54 km/h launch · unpowered coast
Flat route; declared drag and braking hypotheses. Gaps, levitation, force/current maps and flexible motion are not simulated.
Front-position traces do not prove safe separation. Protection, tail clearance and fault stopping require their separate evidence.
